
{{alias}}( str[, radix] )
    Parses a string representation of a 64-bit unsigned integer.

    Parameters
    ----------
    str: string
        String representation of a 64-bit unsigned integer.

    radix: integer (optional)
        Radix (base) to use for string conversion (2-36). Default: 10.

    Returns
    -------
    v: Uint64
        64-bit unsigned integer.

    Examples
    --------
    > var a = {{alias}}( '1234' )
    <Uint64>[ 1234n ]
    > a = {{alias}}( '0xffffffffffffffff' )
    <Uint64>[ 18446744073709551615n ]
    > a = {{alias}}( '123abcxyz', 36 )
    <Uint64>[ 2984992324091n ]

    See Also
    --------
